faq.q: Do you charge for a home valuation?
faq.a: No. The valuation and the listing consultation are free and come with no obligation.
Fees depend on the home and the services you choose; an agent goes through them with you at the consultation. The assistant does not quote fees in chat.

faq.q: Can I tour a home this week?
faq.a: Yes, once you have talked to one of our buyer's agents. Since August 2024 a short written buyer agreement is signed before touring homes with an agent; the agent explains it on the consultation call.

faq.q: Do I need to be pre-approved?
faq.a: Not to talk to us. For touring homes and making offers, sellers usually expect a pre-approval letter or proof of funds. We can introduce you to local lenders; you are free to choose any lender.
